name: Business-Airport Takeshiba
card: A “water airport” on Tokyo Bay, on the 8th floor of Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba
title: Business-Airport Takeshiba — a “water airport” in a smart city, on the 8th floor of Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba Office Tower
lead: Business-Airport Takeshiba, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 8th floor of Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba Office Tower. The website calls it “a water airport floating on Tokyo Bay”: in Takeshiba, a district gaining attention as a new hub for international business, it aims to be a space where people versed in cutting-edge technology inspire one another. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, Saturdays 10:00–18:00 (closed Sundays and holidays) / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: A water airport floating on Tokyo Bay

The website calls Business-Airport Takeshiba “a water airport floating on Tokyo Bay, where new ways of working and communicating are born”. Takeshiba is drawing attention as a new base for international business.

It is a space where engineers versed in the latest technology, gathered in a smart city, can inspire each other. To reach the 8th floor, take the dedicated “Creation Port (8–11F)” elevator from the 6th floor.
steps: From 7:00 on weekdays, and open on Saturdays
Coworking is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and 10:00–18:00 on Saturdays.
Address membership is ¥71,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
Private ROOMs start at ¥176,000 a month, BOOTHs at ¥110,000 and partitioned BOOTHs at ¥385,000.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba was developed as a smart city where engineers gather.
This site's role is to give them a shared place where they can spark ideas in each other.

word.title: What is a smart city?
body: A way of building cities that uses information technology to improve how people live and work. Tokyo Portcity Takeshiba was built on this idea.
Put a workplace in a district full of engineers, and the person at the next desk is more likely to work in your field.

name: Business-Airport Nihonbashi
card: A ground floor whose interior evokes Nihonbashi, the starting point of the Five Routes
title: Business-Airport Nihonbashi — a workplace connecting people and places, with interiors that evoke the starting point of the Five Routes
lead: Business-Airport Nihonbashi, run by Tokyu Land, is on the ground floor of Nihonbashi Front in Nihonbashi 3-chome. Its interior evokes Nihonbashi as the starting point of the Five Routes that once linked Edo to the whole country, and the website says it was created to connect people with people and people with places. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Serviced-office ROOM and DESK / shared workplace / meeting rooms A, B, C / online meeting room / event space / solo work area
Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays 10:00–18:00 / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: From Nihonbashi, the great merchant district, to a new stage

The slogan is “From Nihonbashi, the finest merchant town of its age, to a new stage”. With an interior that recalls Nihonbashi as the starting point of the Five Routes, the website says it has created a new workplace that links people with people and people with places.
A shared workplace, three meeting rooms, an online meeting room, an event space, a solo work area and serviced offices: places for different ways of working line the ground floor.
steps: A shared space recalling the start of the Five Routes
The shared workplace is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and 10:00–18:00 on Sundays and holidays.
Address membership is ¥82,500 a month and Master ¥38,500.
02 · Solo work area and serviced offices
Seats for one, rooms for teams
The solo work area is for focused individual work.
Serviced-office ROOMs start at ¥176,000 a month and DESKs are ¥104,500. They can be entered 24 hours a day.
Three meeting rooms and a place for events
There are three meeting rooms (A, B and C), an online meeting room and an event space.
On the ground floor of a merchant district, it serves as a place where people meet.

word.title: What were the Five Routes?
body: The five highways laid out in the Edo period with Nihonbashi as their starting point: the Tokaido, Nakasendo, Koshu Kaido, Nikko Kaido and Oshu Kaido.
Business-Airport Nihonbashi echoes this starting point in its interior. The brand's idea of a place people depart from overlaps with Nihonbashi's history.

name: .andwork Shibuya
card: A hotel lounge where workers from around the world meet
title: .andwork Shibuya — hybrid coworking in the lounge of The Millennials Shibuya hotel
lead: About a six-minute walk from Shibuya Station, .andwork Shibuya is inside The Millennials Shibuya hotel in Jinnan. The hotel lounge doubles as the workspace — a “hotel hybrid” coworking space where travellers from around the world and local workers share the same room. Drop-in is available from 7:00 to 24:00. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking area / lounge / kitchen / phone booths
Drop-in 7:00–24:00 / weekly and monthly members 24 hours
concept: A global community of workers from around the world

.andwork describes itself as a workplace where striking interior design, good music and conversations with guests and workers from all over the world help you get more creative. The idea is to bring the lift of being on a trip into an ordinary working day.
In Shibuya, the space is inside The Millennials Shibuya. Hotel guests and local members mix in an international lounge, and every evening a happy hour with free beer gets new conversations going.
steps: A self-service kitchen, open around the clock
The self-service kitchen next to the lounge has all the basic cooking tools, so you can make your own meals.
A free coffee machine serves coffee, tea and cocoa 24 hours a day.
The phone booths are free to use — for online meetings and calls without worrying about the people around you.
They can be booked from My Page. Monthly membership costs ¥29,000–34,000 and gives 24-hour access.

word.title: What is “hotel hybrid” coworking?
body: A coworking space set inside a hotel, so the hotel's facilities and the workspace are used together. .andwork calls this its signature style.
Working in a lounge full of travellers brings the feeling of being on a trip into everyday life — a way of putting the extraordinary into the workplace.

name: .andwork Azabu-Juban
card: A grown-up hideaway office for both work and play
title: .andwork Azabu-Juban — a 2nd-floor lounge and a rooftop bar at THE LIVELY Tokyo Azabujuban
lead: .andwork Azabu-Juban is inside THE LIVELY Tokyo Azabujuban hotel in Azabu-Juban 1-chome. Work in the 2nd-floor lounge and end the day at the bar on the top floor: this hotel-hybrid coworking space calls itself “a grown-up hideaway office for both work and play”. It is open from 8:00 to 22:00. Everything below is based on the official website.
concept: A grown-up hideaway office for both work and play

.andwork Azabu-Juban calls itself “a grown-up hideaway office for both work and play”. Work in the 2nd-floor lounge of THE LIVELY Tokyo Azabujuban and relax at the top-floor bar — moving between work and play inside the same hotel.

The .andwork brand aims for workplaces that boost creativity through striking interiors, good music and encounters with guests from around the world. The Azabu-Juban site carries the calm, grown-up air of its neighbourhood.
steps: The 2nd-floor lounge is the workspace, shared by hotel guests and people working in Azabu-Juban.
It costs ¥800 an hour or ¥2,500 a day (no sign-up fee). A 10-visit ticket is ¥17,500.
A place to unwind after work
The hotel's top floor has a bar — a place to spend the evening after a day's work.
Having a place to work and a place to play in the same hotel is what the word “hideaway” means here.
The monthly Unlimited plan costs ¥34,000 a month (sign-up fee ¥10,000).
Open from 8:00 to 22:00, it gives you a work base in the heart of Azabu-Juban.

word.title: What is a hideaway office?
body: The phrase .andwork Azabu-Juban uses for itself: a place where you can move calmly between work and play, away from prying eyes.
Being tucked inside a hotel, hard to see from the street, is what creates the hideaway feeling.

name: co-ba akasaka
card: A calm startup base in Akasaka, one minute from Tameike-Sanno Station
title: co-ba akasaka — 24-hour coworking with roomy desks and chairs for focus, one minute from Tameike-Sanno Station
lead: co-ba akasaka is on the 2nd floor of the Yoshikawa Building in Akasaka 2-chome, a one-minute walk from Tameike-Sanno Station. Calling itself “a calm space for focus, Akasaka's startup base”, it offers a quiet environment and generously sized desks and chairs. Open 24 hours, it has free-address seats, fixed desks, private rooms, meeting rooms, phone booths and an event space. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Free address / fixed desks / private room (12 m², 4–6 people) / meeting space / meeting room / phone booths / event space
concept: A calm space for focus — Akasaka's startup base
co-ba akasaka calls itself “a calm space for focus, Akasaka's startup base”. With a quiet environment and roomy desks and chairs, you can claim your own spot and get to work, the website says.

co-ba is a network of “shared workplaces for every kind of challenge”, and the Ebisu site is one of them. Akasaka, close to government offices and large companies, presents itself as a base for startups.
steps: Free-address membership is ¥16,500 a month and a fixed desk ¥42,790 a month.
In a quiet setting you get generously sized desks and chairs, 24 hours a day.
The private room is 12 m² and holds 4–6 people, at ¥143,000 a month.
A small team can have its own room on the same floor as the coworking space.
Places to talk and to gather
There is a meeting space, a meeting room, phone booths and an event space.
A one-minute walk from exits 9 and 11 of Tameike-Sanno Station, it is easy to invite people for meetings.

word.title: What is free address?
body: A setup with no assigned seat: you use whichever seat is free. At co-ba akasaka it costs ¥16,500 a month.
It is cheaper than a fixed desk, and you can change where you sit depending on your mood that day.

name: Business-Airport Tokyo
card: 3rd floor of Nippon Life Marunouchi Garden Tower, near Tokyo Station
title: Business-Airport Tokyo — where Tokyo's way of working changes, on the 3rd floor of Nippon Life Marunouchi Garden Tower
lead: Business-Airport Tokyo, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 3rd floor of Nippon Life Marunouchi Garden Tower in Marunouchi 1-chome. Its slogan: “Tokyo's work style changes here.” Coworking is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays and 10:00–18:00 on Sundays and holidays, and the serviced offices 24 hours. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays 10:00–18:00 / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: Tokyo's work style changes here
Business-Airport Tokyo's slogan is “Tokyo's work style changes here.” It is on the 3rd floor of Nippon Life Marunouchi Garden Tower in Marunouchi 1-chome, close to Tokyo Station.
Business-Airport is Tokyu Land's brand, named after an airport where diverse people gather and depart. Members of any site can use the coworking areas of every site.
steps: From 7:00 on weekdays, and open on Sundays and holidays
Coworking is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and 10:00–18:00 on Sundays and holidays.
Address membership is ¥99,000 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
Private ROOMs start at ¥396,000 a month and BOOTHs at ¥154,000.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
The meeting room seats six and costs ¥2,750 an hour.
Next to Tokyo Station, it is an easy place to meet people travelling in from afar.

word.title: What is Address membership?
body: A Business-Airport coworking membership that lets you use the site as your company's registered address. At the Tokyo site it costs ¥99,000 a month.
Its value is being able to put a Marunouchi address on your business card.

name: Business-Airport Marunouchi
card: A refined space of reassurance, status, calm and trust
title: Business-Airport Marunouchi — a refined workplace with reassurance and calm, on the 6th floor of the Kishimoto Building
lead: Business-Airport Marunouchi, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 6th floor of the Kishimoto Building in Marunouchi 2-chome. The website describes a refined workplace combining reassurance, status, calm and trust — a space where morale naturally rises. There are three meeting rooms and an online meeting room, and the serviced offices are open 24 hours. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: ROOM / BOOTH / DESK / shared workspace / 3 meeting rooms
Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00 (closed weekends and holidays) / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: Reassurance, status, calm and trust

Business-Airport Marunouchi calls itself “a refined workplace combining reassurance, status, calm and trust”. A space that naturally lifts morale, the website says, promises the next leap for your business.
It is on the 6th floor of the Kishimoto Building, a long-established building in Marunouchi, with a shared workspace, private rooms, booths and fixed desks.
steps: The shared workspace is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and closed on weekends and holidays.
Address membership is ¥99,000 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
Private ROOMs start at ¥214,500 a month, BOOTHs at ¥159,500, and a fixed DESK is ¥132,000.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
Two rooms for eight and one for six
Meeting rooms 1 and 2 seat eight at ¥3,300 an hour; meeting room 3 seats six at ¥2,750. The one-person online meeting room costs ¥550 per 30 minutes.
A calm setting for meetings built on trust.

word.title: Why “status”?
body: The word for social standing and credibility. Business-Airport Marunouchi names it as one of the qualities of a refined workplace.
A Marunouchi address and calm interiors also convey trust to the people who come to visit you.

name: Business-Airport Hibiya
card: A theatre-inspired workplace surrounded by greenery and art
title: Business-Airport Hibiya — a theatre-inspired workplace in harmony with greenery, on the 9th floor of the Toho Hibiya Building
lead: Business-Airport Hibiya, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 9th floor of the Toho Hibiya Building in Yurakucho 1-chome. Surrounded by greenery and art, with a theatre as its motif and plants woven through the space, it is a workplace where people spark each other's creativity and keep sending out diverse culture. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Serviced offices (private) / coworking / meeting rooms A, B, C / online meeting room
Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 10:00–18:00 / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: A theatre motif, in harmony with greenery

The website describes it as “Business-Airport Hibiya, surrounded by greenery and art — a space with a theatre as its motif and in harmony with plants, a workplace where creativity sparks creativity and diverse culture keeps flowing out”.
Hibiya is a district of theatres and cinemas. On the 9th floor of the Toho Hibiya Building, a symbol of the area, is a workplace whose interior recalls a theatre.
steps: From 7:00 on weekdays, and open on weekends and holidays
Coworking is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and 10:00–18:00 on weekends and holidays.
Address membership is ¥82,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
Private rooms for one start at ¥143,000 a month; rooms for several people from ¥272,800.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
One room for eight, two for four
Meeting room A seats eight at ¥3,300 an hour; rooms B and C seat four at ¥2,200 an hour.
The one-person online meeting room costs ¥550 per 30 minutes.

word.title: What does a theatre motif mean?
body: Using the shape and atmosphere of a theatre as the starting point for the interior design. Business-Airport Hibiya is built around this idea.
In Hibiya, the district of theatres and cinemas, the interior takes in the memory of its neighbourhood.
